sources.title: black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The FLUX.2 [klein] model family are our fastest image models to date. FLUX.2 [klein] unifies generation and editing in a single compact architecture, delivering state-of-the-art quality with end-to-end inference in as low as under a second. Built for applications that require real-time image generation without sacrificing quality, and runs on consumer hardware, with as little as 13GB VRAM.
